Provident Real Estate is pleased to present this stunning 3-bedroom villa in Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club - The Residences, offering 3,328.84 sq.ft. of beautifully designed living space in one of Dubai’s most prestigious residential communities.

This villa features a bright open-plan living and dining area, modern kitchen with high-quality finishes, and spacious bedrooms with built-in wardrobes. The master suite includes a luxurious en-suite bathroom, providing a private retreat for residents. With three bathrooms, the villa ensures comfort and convenience for the whole family.
